questions.markdown:
By changing the order of integration evaluate

$$
\int_{0}^{a} \int_{0}^{\sqrt{a^{2}-x^{2}}} \sqrt{a^{2}-x^{2}-y^{2}}\,dy\,dx
$$

Find the volume of the portion of the sphere $x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}=a^{2}$ lying inside the cylinder

$$
x^{2}+y^{2}=ax
$$

By using the transformation $x+y=u$, $y=uv$ evaluate

$$
\int_{0}^{1}\int_{0}^{1-x} e^{\frac{1}{x+y}}\,dy\,dx
$$
reviewNotes: The exponent in the integrand is slightly unclear in the image; transcribed as $\frac{1}{x+y}$ based on visual inspection.

questions.markdown: Find the directional derivative of the function $xy^{2}+yz^{2}+zx^{2}$ along the tangent to the curve $x=t$, $y=t^{2}$, $z=t^{3}$ at the point $(1,1,1)$

Verify Green's theorem for

$$
\oint_{C} 2xy\,dx - y^{2}\,dy
$$

where $C$ is the boundary of the region bounded by the ellipse

$$
3x^{2}+4y^{2}=12
$$

Find the rank of the matrix $A=$

$$
\begin{bmatrix}
0 & 1 & -3 & -1 \\
1 & 0 & 1 & 1 \\
3 & 1 & 0 & 2 \\
1 & 1 & -2 & 0
\end{bmatrix}
$$
